Okay, so I need to figure out if 17 is a prime number. Let me start by recalling what a prime number is. A prime number is a number greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself. So, basically, if I can't divide 17 by any number other than 1 and 17 without getting a remainder, then it's prime.
